content:
incident_bot: PAGERDUTY -> severity=critical for inference-prod-canary: repeated crashloop + eviction spike. runbook: https://internal/runbooks/canary-eviction
erin_oncall: Ack — I'm taking it. Moving to #incidents and paging infra.
sanjay: After the deploy, canary pods went CrashLoopBackOff. HPA is firing hard, nodes under memory pressure.
maya: Which deploy rolled? any manifest changes to HPA?
sanjay: deploy id deploy-2026-03-17-enc-97. Quick dump: ```$ kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=encoder-canary -o wide
NAME                                READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
encoder-canary-5f8b9d7f7d-2xqkz    0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   12         7m
encoder-canary-5f8b9d7f7d-btqrz    0/1     OOMKilled          8          7m
```
erin_oncall: Copy. Paging @leo_prod for node state and recent cordon/drain ops.
leo_prod: Nodes show evictions and kernel oom events. Also saw this in the applied HPA manifest: `targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 8` (looks like a typo, expected ~80). That caused aggressive scaling to tiny pods and memory churn.
maya: ugh. feature flag? can we flip the new encoder off while we mitigate?
leo_prod: I can flip the flag `canary-new-encoder` to false via internal flags API. Doing it now.
devops_bot: Feature flag flip request -> POST /flags/canary-new-encoder -> 200 OK (t=3879990030).
erin_oncall: Good. Also let's scale down canary replicas to 0 and roll back the deployment. Commands: `kubectl scale deploy/encoder-canary --replicas=0 -n prod` then `kubectl rollout undo deployment/encoder -n prod`
sanjay: Executing scale and rollback now. Logs show fewer restarts already.
leo_prod: Nodes are reclaiming memory, eviction rate dropping. HPA spikes stopped after scaling down.
zoe_support: I've seen ~5 customer reports (high latency / 500s) — customers impacted: Acme Corp, BetaApps, GammaRetail. No billing/customer-data impact reported. Informing their CSMs.
erin_oncall: Marking the incident resolved when errors stay low for 5m. I've created INC-2026-0317-01 in the tracker and added initial timeline. Handing off postmortem to @maya.
incident_bot: METRIC CHECK -> error-rate for inference-prod back under SLA (error-rate < 1%) for 6 minutes. Alert auto-resolved.
maya: Will own the postmortem. Initial remediation notes: add CI validation for HPA schema (catch missing/incorrect fields), add a pre-flight check that rejects targetCPU < 30, add a feature-flag gating step before flipping live, and add an alert for sudden HPA target changes.
zoe_support: I'll prepare customer-facing status updates and follow up with impacted accounts.
erin_oncall: Thx team. Handoff complete to @maya. Follow-ups: postmortem due EOD tomorrow, patch for manifest linter in review.
